rows.grounds: subject of the predicate; nominative singular feminine
compound describing highest worthiness of worship
denotes those for whom she is supremely adorable

items.question: What status does primal nature hold as an object of worship for the gods?
premises: Primal nature is declared supremely adorable.
The gods are the ones for whom she is supremely adorable.
The mountain-daughter is addressed in this declaration.
items.inference: Primal nature is the supreme object of worship for the gods.
uncertainties: The verse implies identification of the addressed mountain-daughter with primal nature, though it does not state this equation explicitly.
items.plain_english: O mountain-daughter, primal nature is supremely worthy of worship by the gods.
